items.title: Truist cuts Norwegian Cruise Line to Hold on rising promotional activity
items.summary: Investing.com -- Truist Securities downgraded Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings (NCLH) to Hold from Buy on Thursday, citing the stock's approach to the firm's $20 price target and a rise in promotional activity across the mass-market cruise segment.
